title.en: ProteusWatch: towards a virtual cave laboratory
title.sl: ProteusWatch: na poti do virtualnega jamskega laboratorija

description.en: Plans for long-term monitoring of proteus and its groundwater habitat, bringing together Tular, the Karst Research Institute ZRC SAZU and LifeWatch ERIC. A facility in development, as described in the 2025 update.
description.sl: Načrti za dolgoročno spremljanje človeške ribice in njenega podzemnega habitata povezujejo Tular, Inštitut za raziskovanje krasa ZRC SAZU in LifeWatch ERIC. Objava iz leta 2025 predstavlja laboratorij v razvoju.

title.en: Building virtual laboratories to monitor Proteus anguinus
title.sl: Razvoj virtualnih laboratorijev za spremljanje človeške ribice

description.en: Aljančič and colleagues presented challenges and preliminary results at the LifeWatch ERIC Biodiversity & Ecosystem eScience Conference in Seville (22–24 May 2023, abstract book, p. 27).
description.sl: Aljančič in sodelavci so izzive in prve rezultate predstavili na konferenci LifeWatch ERIC Biodiversity & Ecosystem eScience v Sevilli (22.–24. maj 2023, zbornik povzetkov, str. 27).

title.en: In the Land of the Eyeless Dragons

description.en: Gary Hartley visits Tular and explores how the proposed ProteusWatch laboratory could reveal the health of groundwater ecosystems.
description.sl: Gary Hartley obišče Tular in predstavi, kako bi lahko načrtovani laboratorij ProteusWatch razkrival stanje podzemnih vodnih ekosistemov.

title.en: The underground Karst caves of Postojna

description.en: A conversation with Tanja Pipan, Nataša Ravbar and Gregor Aljančič about the karst underground. LifeWatch ERIC, season 3, episode 10.
description.sl: Pogovor s Tanjo Pipan, Natašo Ravbar in Gregorjem Aljančičem o kraškem podzemlju. LifeWatch ERIC, 3. sezona, 10. epizoda.

description.en: Katie Jewett’s story, with photographs by Luka Dakskobler, follows the Aljančič family’s research and conservation work. Originally published by bioGraphic.
description.sl: Prispevek Katie Jewett s fotografijami Luke Dakskoblerja spremlja raziskovalno in naravovarstveno delo družine Aljančič. Prvotno objavljeno pri bioGraphic.

title.en: Cave Dragons Exist—And Saving Them Could Be Key to Protecting Drinking Water
title.sl: Jamski zmaji obstajajo – njihovo varstvo pomaga varovati pitno vodo

description.en: A feature on Gregor Aljančič, proteus research and the connection between cave conservation and drinking water.
description.sl: Članek o Gregorju Aljančiču, raziskovanju človeške ribice in povezavi med varstvom jam ter pitno vodo.
